what: Behind the dark panel, four blurred light pillars (long rectangles blurred 50·80px) each rotate 0→30° around their own corner over 30s·80s (two reversed), and blink opacity .7 → .4 (25%) → 0 (50%) → .7 on 7·14·10·19s tempos — an aurora shimmers very slowly over the panel.

options.--fx-speed: Speed multiplier (via style), default 1 — 2 means twice as fast
options.--fx-glow-a: Color of the first and third pillars (via style), default is the stage color (--kf-contrast-bg) lightened and turned toward green
options.--fx-glow-b: Color of the second and fourth pillars (via style), default is the stage color brightened and shifted toward blue
options.data-fx-part=\"glow\": Frame holding four pillars — if missing, the part adds them

note: The panel background is painted with --kf-contrast-bg. The pillars sit on the panel’s z-index -1 layer, so the panel gets isolation: isolate (the part css sets it). On phone (768 and below) the pillars are made shorter, as in the original

from.where: shared.css .zb-aurora (News panel · sustainability card · Footer · phone menu) — original c-auroraBg rotate-item 30s/80s · flash 7/14/10/19s
